name: TDGameManager
src_typeComment: Central Tower Defense state: base health (lives) and the shared currency wallet, plus win/lose. TDEnemy reports here (via Instance) on reaching the base or being killed; assign a WaveSpawner and surviving its last wave (with the base still alive) fires OnVictory automatically.

src_serialized.name: baseHealth
src_serialized.tooltip: Base/core health — reaching 0 ends the game as a loss.

src_serialized.name: wallet
src_serialized.tooltip: Wallet that tower kills add currency to, and tower placement spends from.

src_serialized.name: waveSpawner
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional — if assigned, all waves completing (with the base still alive) triggers OnVictory.

src_members.sig: public void GrantCurrency(CurrencyDefinition currency, int amount) => wallet?.Add(currency, amount)
src_members.name: GrantCurrency

src_members.sig: public bool TrySpendCurrency(CurrencyDefinition currency, int amount) => wallet != null && wallet.TrySpend(currency, amount)
src_members.name: TrySpendCurrency
